content: प्रेरणम्, -णा .²1 Driving or urging on, impelling, inciting, instigation. .²2 Impulse, passion. .²3 Throwing, casting; ह्रीमूढानां भवति विफलप्रेरणा चूर्णमुष्टिः <ls>Me. 70</ls>. .²4 Sending, despatching. .²5 Order, direction. .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The sense of the causal form. .²7 Activity, exertion.
